pr_title: Add `_get_unsaved_status()` method to EditorPlugin and implement it for script and shader editors
pr_body:
This PR adds `_get_unsaved_status()`. When editor is being closed, it calls this method on every plugin. The method returns a string. If the string is not empty, its content will be displayed in save confirmation dialog and the user can normally choose to save or discard. If the returned string is empty, the editor will close normally.

I implemented this method for script editor and shader editor, so unsaved scripts will now prompt on editor exit. Unfortunately you can't discard them due to #18010

Fixes #55026
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/36281
Supersedes #55586
pr_comments:
Rebased and ready for review. I did a small modification: `get_unsaved_status()` is now called when closing a scene and passes the scene path as an argument. This allows to handle built-in resources and effectively fixes #44053

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/230134317-fa0b0a90-009d-4f0b-ac25-0ad56fd1f707.mp4

I added it as another commit, but I can rebase it into 2 commits if that's better.

issue_context.title: Modifying a built-in script doesn't mark the scene as modified
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2

**Issue description:**
When you modify a built-in script, the script nor scene containing it isn't marked as modified. This potentially leads to accidentally unsaved changes on quit.
![EbT7Y98UnP](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/74612411-810caf80-5105-11ea-89b2-a4cc896526fd.gif)


**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Create a scene
2. Add a built-in script
3. Save
4. Type something in the script

EDIT:
This also affects Shaders.
comments: perhaps that is also the reason why built-in scripts are not being updated when you edit them during test play? or would that be another issue?
